title: 10 Best Oxalis Stricta Preparations

Teas made from dried leaves are commonly used to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. Decoctions, which involve boiling the root or leaves, are valued for their stronger potency in treating skin conditions. Mucillages, derived from the plant’s gel-like substance, are used to promote wound healing and as a demulcent. Creams infused with Oxalis stricta extracts are applied topically to alleviate pain and irritation.
